title: The cohomology of the I^nF is a finite module over the Rees algebra
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $B=\mathcal R_A(I)=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}I^nt^n\subseteq A[t]$ the Rees algebra of $I$ [def-nagata-rees-algebra] (the subring of $A[t]$ of the polynomials whose coefficient of $t^n$ lies in $I^n$ for every $n$), $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ the image of $f^*\widetilde I\to f^*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\to\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $\mathcal I^0\mathcal F=\mathcal F$ and, for $n\ge1$, let $\mathcal I^n\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal F$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0). Fix $q\ge0$ and write $M_n=H^q(X,\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$ for $n\ge0$ (sheaf cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology]; an $A$-module, $a\in A$ acting through its image $f^\sharp(a)\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$). For $k,m\ge0$ and $a\in I^k$, multiplication by $f^\sharp(a)$ maps $\mathcal I^m\mathcal F$ into $\mathcal I^{m+k}\mathcal F$ (on every open $U$, $f^\sharp(a)|_U$ is a section of $\mathcal I^k$); let $\lambda^{(m)}_a:\mathcal I^m\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^{m+k}\mathcal F$ be this $\mathcal O_X$-linear map and, for $x\in M_m$, put $a\star x=H^q(X,\lambda^{(m)}_a)(x)\in M_{m+k}$. Then: (1) $M=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}M_n$ is a $B$-module under $\big(\sum_ka_kt^k\big)\cdot(x_m)_{m\ge0}=\big(\sum_{k+m=n}a_k\star x_m\big)_{n\ge0}$ ($a_k\in I^k$, $x_m\in M_m$, almost all zero), and for $a\in A=I^0$ and $x\in M_m$ the element $a\star x$ is the product $ax$ of the $A$-module structure of $M_m$; (2) $M$ is a finitely generated $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 02O8 (lemma-cohomology-powers-ideal-times-F, line 5380; reference EGA III Cor 3.3.2) and the paragraph before it (lines 5370-5376), which gives M = (+)_n H^p(X, I^n F) its structure of graded S = (+)_n I^n-module; Stacks' proof applies Lemma 0897 (lemma-graded-finiteness) part (1) to the finite type graded f^*B~-module (+)_n I^n F. Stacks writes I^nF for the image of f^*(I^n)~ (x) F -> F, which equals (I O_X)^n F as used here. Tags verified in tags/tags: 02O8, 0897.
